visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Compute the Percentage with Integers
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The percentage is computed with three doubles and a cast. Compute it with integer arithmetic, multiplying before dividing. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Multiplying by 100 first keeps the precision of the integer division, so no floating-point numbers or casts are needed. Floating-point values can also be slightly off (0.1 + 0.2 is not exactly 0.3).
